summary: Implementation plan for Unified Lesson Cycle Numbering across Glück: single authoritative chronological numbering engine in lessonUtils.ts, consistent resequencing across all AppContext mutation paths, unified display and persistence across LessonReminderModal, ArabicParentReportModal, ParentSummaryModal, LessonControlModal, TodaysProgressTimeline, and GroupProfileModal, and full automated test suite (Tests A–P).
